query:
SELECT f.dia, f.mes, f.ano, e.slug, f.cat5
FROM faturamentos f
JOIN empresas e ON f.empresaId = e.id
WHERE f.mes = 3 AND f.ano = 2026 AND f.dia = 1 AND e.slug IN ('MORUMBI', 'MASCOTE')
ORDER BY e.slug;
